versions.changelog:
- User approval for sending inputs to Vestafolio's API is now required before calculation; inputs and destination are summarized for consent.
- If the TMI is unknown, user approval is also needed for sending household and salary details to the impot-revenu API; fallback to user-assumed TMI if declined.
- Skill workflows, consent policies, and data handling instructions have been updated and clarified.
- Removed sample file "skill-card.md".

- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to the simulator logic, API usage, or user workflow.
- No impact on the use or capabilities of the skill itself.

- Initial release of the "vestafolio-sasu-vs-eurl" skill.
- Compares net director income between SASU (assimilé salarié) and EURL (TNS) for French solo entrepreneurs using the Vestafolio simulator API.
- Asks all relevant financial and personal questions before computing or recommending a structure.
- Provides grounded, simulator-based results only—no manual or hypothetical calculations.
- Clearly states all necessary assumptions and limits; offers a link to the interactive simulator if calculation cannot be completed.
